chat.wordAnalysisDescription: Each path shows token probabilities returned by the model and their product. If multiple paths form the same word, their scores are added. Because the chat API requires a new request containing the partial prefix—it cannot continue the exact internal token stream—the product is an approximate score, not an exact joint probability. Search explores at most three tokens per step, nine active paths, eight tokens per word, and 36 queries; the sum covers explored paths only, not all probability mass for the word.
